summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence and containment work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; all four legal tasks remain open; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and attribution gates remain incomplete; compliance baseline is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Amazon revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 and $4.92 remains aggregate and unattributed. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Tracking remains active with 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Partial progress: official Woot API, terms, and support evidence; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts. No task is closable because required field-level rights, retention, deletion, consent, vendor, incident, and non-legal gate evidence is incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. Do not change the private gate or send outreach.

Woot API deal and price-history data: counsel_required. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Retain complicated.work parked: it is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks. Next evidence action: remediate in isolation and rerun the same compliance checks. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked: DNS fetch failed and reachability, compliance, analytics, monetization, and launch evidence are unknown. Next evidence action: complete a dated reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision checklist before any launch step. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth, but failed or unknown compliance gates remain site-specific blockers.

Do not grant fleet-wide legal clearance. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics and attribution data quality are yellow; repair source permissions or collector errors and do not treat failures as zero. Preserve Amazon's $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed; do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. Continue only existing affiliate-reference validation and attribution reconciliation.

Reject new launch, monetization, tracking, deployment, requeue, spend, and external-outreach actions this cycle. Retain existing repair, measurement, legal evidence, security evidence, and parked-site work. Reconsider public exposure only after legal data-use dispositions, human-counsel review where required, security evidence, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates are satisfied.
